meta.title: iOS Trainer
lang.label: Language
home.title: iOS Trainer
home.lead: Short, interactive courses to go from zero to iOS architect: Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, architectures, testing, shipping, subscriptions and more. In every course you learn, practice, review and get assessed.
home.coursesDesc: 20 courses in order, from Swift from scratch to system design. Each one has lessons, review and an exam.
home.practiceLead: Standalone practice modes, originally built for the TestGorilla assessment.
home.mode.lessons: Standalone lessons on Swift, algorithms, REST, engineering and iOS.
home.mode.theory: A summary of the whole syllabus to review the day before: snippets, traps, checklist.
home.mode.flashcards: Flip the card and decide whether you knew it. The ones you miss come back.
home.mode.quiz: TestGorilla-style multiple choice; every answer explains why.
home.mode.output: Read Swift and guess what it prints. Trains the language's traps.
home.mode.code: Solve the challenge from memory without autocomplete; get a checklist and the solution.
home.mode.bugs: Click the line with the bug and learn the pattern.
home.mode.interview: Answer out loud or in writing, compare with key points and rate yourself.
home.route.1: Follow the Courses in order: each one builds on the previous ones.
home.route.2: In each course: lessons → flashcard review → exam (you pass with 70%).
home.route.3: Use Free practice to build speed: predict the output, bug hunt, write the code.
home.route.4: Before an interview: course 20, Interview and Quick reference.
lessons.title: Interactive lessons
lessons.lead: Each lesson explains a concept with examples and their output, and makes you practice it right away: predict what it prints, fill the gap or write the function. You can't move on until you solve the exercise. Follow the order: each one builds on the previous one.
player.reviewPrev: Review the previous explanation and try again.
player.patternNote: Pattern check only, Swift is not executed. Compare with the solution to fine-tune.
quiz.title: Quiz with feedback
quiz.lead: Multiple-choice questions like the 10-minute TestGorilla tests. Every answer explains why, whether you got it right or not.
output.title: Predict the output
output.lead: Read the Swift code and decide what it prints (or whether it compiles). The most direct training for the language's traps.
output.question: What does this code print?
flash.title: Flashcards
flash.lead: Read the question, answer in your head, flip it and be honest: "I knew it" removes it from the deck, "Repeat" sends it to the back.
flash.deckDoneText: No cards left with this filter. Switch topic or turn off "Pending only" to review everything.
code.title: Write the code
code.lead: No autocomplete, like the TestGorilla editor. Write the whole function from memory and submit: you get a checklist of what a good solution needs, warnings about common mistakes and the reference solution to compare.
code.note: This check looks for the key constructs; it doesn't run Swift. Compare with the solution and walk through your edge cases: empty, one element, duplicates, k > n.
bugs.title: Bug hunt
bugs.lead: Like the "Coding: Debugging" test: read the description, find the line that breaks the behavior and click it.
bugs.wrongLine: No. The bug is on line {n}.
interview.title: Technical interview
interview.lead: Questions that may come up as custom questions (essay or video) and in the technical interview. Answer out loud or write your answer, then compare with the key points and rate yourself.
interview.placeholder: Write your answer (or say it out loud and note the points you mentioned)…
interview.autoNote: Points detected in your text are checked automatically; tick the ones you said out loud.
interview.scale: 1 = no idea where to start · 3 = the idea but disorganized · 5 = ready to say it in an interview.

sync.title: ☁️ Progress across devices
sync.desc: Pick a code (6+ characters, letters/numbers/dashes) and use it on every device: progress is saved to the cloud and merged with local progress. Nobody without the code can see it; don't use a real password.
sync.state.error: Sync error (retries on the next change)
sync.state.unavailable: Server has no database configured: local only
courses.title: Courses
courses.lead: 20 courses in teaching order, from Swift from scratch to iOS architect. Each course: interactive lessons, a final challenge, review flashcards and an exam.
courses.loadError: Couldn't load the course. Check your connection and reload.
courses.levelsHelp: N0 fundamentals · N1 junior · N2 mid · N3 senior · N4 architect
exam.intro: {n} multiple-choice questions. You pass with 70%. Every answer is explained.
exam.question: Question {n} / {total}
exam.passed: Passed. Move on to the next course.
exam.failed: Not yet: review the lessons and flashcards and try again.
